name: Webel Siliguri Data Centre
developer: Webel Technology Limited (West Bengal Electronics Industry Development Corporation)
notes: Webel is coming up with a new data centre at Siliguri (Darjeeling district), reported under construction as of Sep 2023 (Millennium Post); CM Mamata Banerjee inaugurated the Webel IT Park in north Bengal (Siliguri) which hosts state e-governance/IT infrastructure. First-round discovery had graded this operational; the Wikipedia WB data centre list (refs to Sep 2023 reporting) lists the Siliguri Webel data centre as under construction, so construction is used here with capacity not disclosed.

name: Yotta (Hiranandani) Kolkata / Uttarpara Hyperscale Data Center Park
notes: Hiranandani Group signed an MoU with the West Bengal government (2021) for Yotta to build six hyperscale data centre buildings at Uttarpara, Hooghly (Hugli) district, with a combined ~250 MW capacity; Wikipedia WB list and maritimegateway confirm the Uttarpara, Hooghly siting. Yotta's current operational portfolio (NM1 Navi Mumbai, D1 Greater Noida) does not yet include Kolkata; no construction evidence found as of Aug 2026, so status remains planned/MoU.

name: STT GDC Kolkata 1 (Ultadanga)
developer: STT GDC India (ST Telemedia Global Data Centres)
notes: STT GDC operates its Kolkata data centre at Ultadanga, Kolkata district: 2.4 MW capacity, approx 20,000 sq ft, operational colocation facility per the operator official location page and the Wikipedia WB list.

name: Tata Communications Kolkata Data Center (Ultadanga)
notes: Tata Communications runs a ~6 MW data centre at Ultadanga, Kolkata district, operational per the Wikipedia WB list citing Tata Communications integrated report; graded B pending direct operator page confirmation.

name: NIC Kolkata Data Centre (Nizam Palace)

notes: NIC operates a government data centre at Nizam Palace, Kolkata (approx 250 TB storage, 1,200 sq ft, 20 racks) per the NIC Kolkata DC official/about page and Wikipedia WB list. Government facility; no commercial MW published.
